meta.name: rehydrate
meta.description: Put the real values back into an analysis that was produced from GREEN (placeholder) text — LOCALLY, using the user's own reversible map. Completes the confide round-trip (redact -> cloud-analyze the green -> rehydrate locally). Use when the user says "rehydrate", "restore real names", "unmask the analysis", "put the names back", "de-redact this output", "reverse the placeholders", or hands you an analysis full of [CONFIDE_PERSON_0001]/[CONFIDE_DATE_0002] plus a *.map.json. Runs only on the user's own map; the map never leaves the machine; nothing fetched or transmitted. Prints counts only — never echoes restored PII. Warns on placeholders not in the map (possible LLM hallucination).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用本地映射还原分析中的真实姓名和日期
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要对云端分析结果进行本地脱敏还原
copy.tagline_en: Restore real values into anonymized analysis using your local map
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to safely de-redact cloud analysis results locally

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以把包含占位符（如 [CONFIDE_PERSON_0001]）的分析文本恢复成真实值。恢复过程使用你自己的映射文件，只输出恢复成功的数量，不泄露隐私信息。
howto.when: 当你要求“rehydrate”“恢复真实姓名”“取消掩码”等，或提供包含占位符的分析文件和映射文件时触发。

say.text: 帮我rehydrate这个分析文件，映射是session.map.json
say.note: Claude 会用指定映射恢复占位符。

say.text: 恢复真实姓名，检查analysis.txt中的占位符
say.note: Claude 会提示恢复数量和未匹配项。

say.text: 把占位符替换回原名，并报告未匹配的
say.note: 未匹配项可能是幻觉，Claude 会警告。

howto.what_en: Installing this skill allows Claude to replace placeholders (e.g., [CONFIDE_PERSON_0001]) in an analysis text with real values using your local map file. It only prints count statistics and never leaks the restored data.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "rehydrate", "restore real names", "unmask the analysis", etc., or provide an analysis with placeholders and a map file.

say_en.note: Claude uses the specified map to restore placeholders.
Claude shows restore count and any unmatched placeholders.

say_en.text: Replace placeholders and warn about unmatched ones
